SPECIFICATION FOR SPADE-GRIP TERMINAL 
DEVICE FOR ARTIFICIAL LIMBS 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for spade-grip terminal device. 

2. Material™ The spade grip shall be manufactured from carbon ateel conforming to class 2 of 
Table 1 of 13:1875-1978 * Specification for carbon steel billets, blooms, slabs and bars for forgings 
i first revision)'. The pins ^hall be manufactured from materials conforming to 15:1148-1973 
* Specification for hot-rolled steel rivet bars ( up to 40 mm diameter ) for structural purposes ( second 
revision)'. The wing headed clamping screw shall be of carbon steel conforming to IS:7283-1973 
' Specification for hot-roiled bars for production of bright bars '.

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The spade grip shall be manufactured by forging carbon steel. The jaws shall be in perfect 
alignment with each other and shall open and close evenly. The serrations shall be neatly cut to 
provide a firm grip. The device shall be free from pits, cracks, scale, seams, fins and other defects. 
The movement of the jaws at the ball type joint shall be without any play or undue stiffness. All 
surfaces shall be plated chromium over nicl^el. The plating shall conform to Service Grade 3 of 
13:1068-1968 'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel 
(first revision ) \ 

5. Hardness — The spade grip shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 300 to 350 HV 

at the jaws. 

6. Test 

6.1 Drop Test — The spade grip shall be dropped from a height of 2 m, with the gripping jaws 
pointing downwards, on a hard floor. This procedure shall be carried out 5 times. At the end of 
this test the spade grip shall not have broken or developed cracks. 

7. Marlting — The spade grip shall be clearly and legibly marked with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification MarA/nflf — Details available with. the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing 

8.1 The spade grip shall be packed in the manner as agreed to between the purchaser and the 
supplier*. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Terminal devices for artiftcial limbs are working accessories to be fitted into the dress or work- 
ing arm of an amputee of the upper extremity. The devices aid the amputee to perform some of the 
normal functions of the hand. This revision incorporates the change in many dimensions as sugges-
